{{Top|leg}}
The '''Talents''' were the sixth highest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]] below the [[Prosperines]]. They were [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who worked in skilled labor fields. [[Xan/Legends|Xan]] were not allowed to ascend beyond the level of Talent.
